item.description:
What's New in v2.4.0

  • Renamed the "AI Models" tab to "Dictation Models", and removed the unused "Transcribe Audio" tab.
  • Refreshed the transcription model list: dropped slow, outdated local models, added a compact Small option, and added OpenAI and AssemblyAI as cloud options.
  • Enhancement now lets you download and switch between several on-device models (Gemma 1B through 27B).
  • New Coding and Chat enhancement prompts for cleaner dictation of code and casual messages.
